figures.name: fig1_profile_base.png
figures.caption: Base-case mean profile: OSS-transplant (AO_OS), repo path with ported forcing (AR_OS) and the repository's own convention (AR_RS) against the closed-form parabola; all three coincide within 0.15% of u_max.

figures.name: fig2_convergence.png
figures.caption: u_max error versus channel height (log-log) for the three arms; second-order decay means the anchor error is a discretisation error, not a model error.

figures.name: fig3_sensitivity.png
figures.caption: Left: u_max error versus BGK relaxation rate (omega = 1.818 ... 0.667); right: error versus force magnitude squared, showing the forcing-convention effect is a second-order (Ma^2) effect.

figures.name: fig4_shape_invariant.png
figures.caption: u_max/u_mean versus u_max: the exact parabola gives 1.5, so this isolates a profile-shape error (wall modelling) from an amplitude error (viscosity).
